# Helper Triggers for 5 Hybridization Arcs & 7 Cultural Capitals

oe_cul2_owns_any_cultural_capital = {
	OR = {
		location:constantinople = { has_owner = yes owner = prev }
		location:rome = { has_owner = yes owner = prev }
		location:paris = { has_owner = yes owner = prev }
		location:dadu = { has_owner = yes owner = prev }
		location:cairo = { has_owner = yes owner = prev }
		location:samarkand = { has_owner = yes owner = prev }
		location:moscow = { has_owner = yes owner = prev }
	}
}

# Arc 1: Greco-Anatolian Synthesis (BYZ/ROM/TUR bridging Greek and Turkish Anatolia)
oe_cul2_hyb1_eligible = {
	is_rebel_country = no
	NOT = { has_variable = oe_cul2_hyb1_done }
	current_year >= 1360
	OR = {
		has_or_had_tag = BYZ
		has_or_had_tag = ROM
		has_or_had_tag = TUR
	}
	OR = {
		culture = { has_culture_group = culture_group:greek_group }
		culture = culture:turkish_culture
	}
	any_owned_location = {
		region = region:anatolia_region
		count >= 8
	}
	OR = {
		has_primary_or_accepted_culture = culture:turkish_culture
		has_primary_or_accepted_culture = culture:greek_culture
		has_primary_or_accepted_culture = culture:oe_tur_greek_culture
		has_primary_or_accepted_culture = culture:cappadocian_greek_culture
		any_owned_location = {
			region = region:anatolia_region
			OR = {
				dominant_culture ?= culture:turkish_culture
				dominant_culture ?= culture:greek_culture
				dominant_culture ?= culture:oe_tur_greek_culture
			}
		}
	}
}

# Arc 2: Magna Graecia & Italo-Byzantine Maritime Synthesis
oe_cul2_hyb2_eligible = {
	is_rebel_country = no
	NOT = { has_variable = oe_cul2_hyb2_done }
	current_year >= 1375
	OR = {
		has_or_had_tag = BYZ
		has_or_had_tag = ROM
		has_or_had_tag = VEN
		has_or_had_tag = GEN
		has_or_had_tag = NAP
	}
	OR = {
		AND = {
			culture = { has_culture_group = culture_group:greek_group }
			OR = {
				any_owned_location = { region = region:italy_region }
				has_primary_or_accepted_culture = culture:griko_culture
				has_primary_or_accepted_culture = culture:oe_latin_greek_culture
				has_primary_or_accepted_culture = culture:venetian
				has_primary_or_accepted_culture = culture:neapolitan
			}
		}
		AND = {
			culture = { has_culture_group = culture_group:italian_group }
			OR = {
				any_owned_location = {
					region = region:balkan_region
					dominant_culture ?= culture:greek_culture
				}
				has_primary_or_accepted_culture = culture:greek_culture
				has_primary_or_accepted_culture = culture:griko_culture
			}
		}
	}
}

# Arc 3: Great Yuan Sino-Mongol-Semu Synthesis
oe_cul2_hyb3_eligible = {
	is_rebel_country = no
	NOT = { has_variable = oe_cul2_hyb3_done }
	current_year >= 1355
	OR = {
		has_or_had_tag = CHI
		has_or_had_tag = YUA
		has_or_had_tag = MNG
	}
	OR = {
		culture = { has_culture_group = culture_group:mongolian_group }
		culture = { has_culture_group = culture_group:chinese_group }
	}
	location:dadu = {
		has_owner = yes
		owner = prev
	}
	any_accepted_culture = {
		count >= 2
	}
}

# Arc 4: Russo-Kipchak Steppe & Cossack Frontier Synthesis
oe_cul2_hyb4_eligible = {
	is_rebel_country = no
	NOT = { has_variable = oe_cul2_hyb4_done }
	current_year >= 1380
	OR = {
		has_or_had_tag = MOS
		has_or_had_tag = RUS
		has_or_had_tag = NOV
		has_or_had_tag = GLH
	}
	OR = {
		culture = { has_culture_group = culture_group:russian_group }
		culture = { has_culture_group = culture_group:tatar_group }
		culture = { has_culture_group = culture_group:steppe_group }
	}
	OR = {
		any_owned_location = {
			region = region:steppes_region
			count >= 4
		}
		has_primary_or_accepted_culture = culture:oe_don_cossack
		has_primary_or_accepted_culture = culture:oe_volga_cossack
		has_primary_or_accepted_culture = culture:kazani
		has_primary_or_accepted_culture = culture:mishar
	}
}

# Arc 5: Balkan Greco-Slavic Orthodox Commonwealth
oe_cul2_hyb5_eligible = {
	is_rebel_country = no
	NOT = { has_variable = oe_cul2_hyb5_done }
	current_year >= 1365
	OR = {
		has_or_had_tag = BYZ
		has_or_had_tag = ROM
		has_or_had_tag = SER
		has_or_had_tag = BUL
	}
	religion = religion:orthodox
	any_owned_location = {
		region = region:balkan_region
		count >= 10
	}
	OR = {
		AND = {
			culture = { has_culture_group = culture_group:greek_group }
			OR = {
				has_primary_or_accepted_culture = culture:bulgarian
				has_primary_or_accepted_culture = culture:serbian
				has_primary_or_accepted_culture = culture:oe_bulgarian_greek_culture
				has_primary_or_accepted_culture = culture:oe_serbian_greek_culture
				any_owned_location = {
					region = region:balkan_region
					dominant_culture ?= { has_culture_group = culture_group:south_slavic_group }
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			culture = { has_culture_group = culture_group:south_slavic_group }
			OR = {
				has_primary_or_accepted_culture = culture:greek_culture
				any_owned_location = {
					region = region:balkan_region
					dominant_culture ?= culture:greek_culture
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

oe_cul2_any_hybrid_arc_eligible = {
	OR = {
		oe_cul2_hyb1_eligible = yes
		oe_cul2_hyb2_eligible = yes
		oe_cul2_hyb3_eligible = yes
		oe_cul2_hyb4_eligible = yes
		oe_cul2_hyb5_eligible = yes
	}
